turnaround_reason: EPAM fell ~54% from its $222 high as the market priced in AI cannibalizing traditional digital-engineering/staff-augmentation spend and a demand air-pocket while clients pivot budgets to AI-led modernization. It remains a real, profitable, net-cash business that keeps beating estimates, so the drawdown looks more sentiment- than fundamentals-driven.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 beat: EPS $3.38 (+22% YoY, +7.6% vs est), revenue $1.415B (+4.5% YoY); third straight beat
AI-native revenue accelerating, now >11% of total business with double-digit sequential growth
Cheap for the quality: forward P/E ~7.3, EV/EBITDA ~6, net cash ($789M cash vs $152M debt)
Analyst consensus 'buy' (17 analysts), mean target ~$123 (~19% upside), strong FCF ($650M)
Screener already carries EPAM as a conv-7 watchlist name -1.7% since add
bearish_points: Guidance tempered: full-year growth only 3.2-4.2%; big AI opportunities pushed to 1H 2027, so a near-term revenue gap as legacy work rolls off faster than AI work ramps
AI is a genuine structural threat to labor-arbitrage IT-services, not just a scare
High short interest (~22% of float) signals the bear thesis has real adherents
Basing, not confirmed recovering: -29% below 200d MA, could re-break lower on a soft print
Dossier news feed was empty (yfinance nulls); view built from earnings + web catalyst check
catalyst: AI-native revenue mix crossing a threshold where reaccelerating growth is undeniable, plus stabilization of North American discretionary IT spend; next hard datapoint is Q3 print
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings ~Nov 5, 2026; larger AI-led revenue inflection guided to 1H 2027
suggested_trade: Starter spot position now (small-to-medium), add on a pullback toward the low-$90s or on confirmed reacceleration. Optionally Jan 2027 calls given cheap-ish IV.
key_risk: AI-led modernization replaces legacy engineering revenue more slowly than it cannibalizes it, producing 1-2 quarters of flat/negative growth that re-rates the stock lower before the 2027 inflection.
would_skip_if: Q3 guide cuts full-year below 3% or AI-native mix growth stalls, confirming the bear demand-gap thesis.
